posts.title: Cursed Scroll #1 Bestiary Conversion
posts.description: I am prepping The Gloaming, a hexcrawl found in Cursed Scroll #1 (Shadowdark), for my players in a new Distant Lands campaign and wanted to share my bestiary notes here. This is fully compatible with Cairn, other than Mugdulblub's corrupting effect. Instead of saving for corruption, replace it with this: Mutagenic: Creatures within melee range have a 1-in-6 chance on their turn of suffering a muta
